reader_summary.headline: The internet, believe it or not, was just the beginning.
reader_summary.overview: The internet, believe it or not, was just the beginning. Yes, it spawned an incredible number of uses (some unexpected), from marketplaces and commerce to publishing and social networks... but that’s all been built with old models of funding and coordination.

key_points.text: Now, as we enter a new phase of blockchain-enabled innovation -- decentralized, distributed, crowdfunded -- we’re finally bringing capitalism to open source.
In this brief discussion from a16z Summit November 2017.
